events.evidence: JP Morgan Chase & Co. announced a settlement of a lawsuit brought against it by Enron investors who claim that it helped the management of that company defraud them. JP Morgan will pay claimants US$2.
A TNS/MRBI Irish Times opinion poll predicts that Ireland, previously seen as certain to vote yes, is likely to vote no in its planned referendum on the European Constitution.
22 people have died following a suicide bombing in Kirkuk, northern Iraq

label.note: JP Morgan Enron settlement, Irish EU referendum risk and Iraq violence are mildly risk-negative.
